# Lie subalgebra generated by vectors

`lie_algebra.subalgebra.generated.compute` accepts a finite-dimensional Lie
algebra over `QQ` and up to its dimension many vectors expressed on that
algebra's ordered basis. It returns the smallest Lie subalgebra containing
those vectors, as canonical reduced row echelon rows in a `LieSubalgebra`
value bound to the exact ambient algebra. The empty family generates the zero
subalgebra.

The kernel repeatedly adjoins brackets of the current spanning rows and
canonicalizes their span until its dimension stabilizes. The number of strict
dimension increases is at most the ambient dimension. Admission establishes
the Jacobi identity, bounds generator coordinates, closure work, and a
conservative coefficient-growth envelope before bracket closure begins.
Independent of the construction algorithm, the result is closed under the
ambient bracket and contains every supplied generator; every bracket-closed
subspace containing the inputs therefore contains the returned space.

The value composes directly with `lie_algebra.subalgebra.check` and the
operations consuming an ambient-bound `LieSubalgebra`. This operation
constructs a subalgebra, without claiming it is an ideal.

See Sage's [finite-dimensional Lie algebra documentation](https://doc.sagemath.org/html/en/reference/categories/sage/categories/finite_dimensional_lie_algebras_with_basis.html)
for the established generated-subalgebra interface.
